name: devops
description: CI/CD for the crew: sets up GitHub Actions that run a repo's own checks, gives every pull request a review link (a preview deployment on Cloudflare Pages or Render, published as a GitHub Deployment), and triages failing runs to a cause and an owner. Never handles secret values. Use when asked to set up CI or CI/CD, add PR previews or review links, fix a workflow, or find why CI is red.
